panels.description: Findings an author marked wrong or disagreed with (their latest signal), with no adjudication yet, per owning team.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT m.owner AS "Owner", count(DISTINCT e.finding_id) AS "Waiting",
  round(max(extract(epoch FROM now() - e.observed_at)) / 86400.0, 1) AS "Oldest (days)"
FROM effective_events e
JOIN findings o ON o.id = e.finding_id
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT ru.status, ru.owner FROM rule_runs rr
  JOIN rules ru ON ru.rule_id = rr.rule_id AND ru.version_sha = rr.rule_version
  WHERE rr.rule_id = o.rule_id ORDER BY rr.id DESC LIMIT 1) m ON true
WHERE e.role = 'author' AND e.kind IN ('fb_wrong', 'fb_disagree')
  AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM feedback_events a WHERE a.finding_id = e.finding_id AND a.kind LIKE 'adjudicated\_%')
GROUP BY m.owner ORDER BY "Waiting" DESC

panels.title: Waiting for the owner

targets.rawSql:
SELECT f.rule_id AS "Rule", count(*) FILTER (WHERE e.kind = 'adjudicated_uphold') AS "Upheld",
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE e.kind = 'adjudicated_overturn') AS "Overturned"
FROM feedback_events e JOIN findings f ON f.id = e.finding_id
WHERE e.kind LIKE 'adjudicated\_%' AND $__timeFilter(e.observed_at)
GROUP BY f.rule_id ORDER BY 3 DESC, 2 DESC
